_comment: Base config for rate.test.mjs. Every case copies this, mutates one thing,
and writes it into a temp directory; the suite rewrites ratings_log.path
and credentials.service_account_key_path to temp paths before use.
It must never resolve to the real ratings log or a real credential. The
secret name and project are obviously-fake on purpose: no case in the
suite reaches a network call, and if one ever did, these values would fail
